g.text: Components are in-process responsibilities, not independently deployed services.
[grouped] boxes combine named classes for readability; they are not separate Java packages.
An arrow from a group means at least one member uses the target, not every member.
Service collaboration arrows come from actual dependencies; repository access is aggregated.
Services construct web.dto records; command responses often include a refreshed OverviewResponse.
Loyalty and notifications run on access. Points expiry is calculated without a scheduled sweep.
Clock / ZoneId injection and startup wiring are omitted as edges. Purple = configuration.
